title: New request
subtitle: A call, a visit, a fair or a letter: write it down as they asked. It lands in Incoming like a portal request.
fromMailTitle: Make a request from this mail

from.label: From
from.customerHint: One of the customers you make requests for
from.prospectHint: Not a customer yet: made one before the quote
from.pickPlaceholder: Search your customers by name or code
from.pickFailed: Your customers could not be read
from.pickNone: You make requests for no customer at this company: record a prospect
from.pickMore: The first {shown} of {count}: type to find the others
from.contactHint: The person who asked, if they are a contact of the customer
from.contactsFailed: The customer's contacts could not be read
from.basisWhy: Why we may keep their details (GDPR art. 6). A request for a quote is a step they asked for, so “Steps at their request” fits most requests.
from.match: {name} is already one of your customers.
from.matchBody: Use the customer: a second record of the same company would split its requests and mail.

subject.hint: Empty: the first line of the message is used.

message.label: What they asked
message.hint: Their words as they said or wrote them: the call's notes, the letter's text. The request's first card shows it as written.

problem.tooLong: The subject and the message are 20 000 characters at most together.
problem.refLong: Their PO is {max} characters at most.
problem.datePast: The day wanted is today or later.
problem.shipTo: That is not one of this customer's delivery addresses: choose another one.

details.none: Nothing here is needed to create the request.
details.refHint: The customer's own order number, if they gave one.
details.dateHint: The day they would like the goods. Our answer says what we can do.
details.shipToHint: One of the customer's delivery addresses.
details.shipToWaiting: An address the customer added in its portal: it is checked before the first delivery.
details.shipToFailed: The customer's delivery addresses could not be read.

kept.offline: Offline: what you typed stays in this window.

office.title: For the office
office.linesHint: Optional: turn what they asked into lines (a style, its colourway, pieces by size). Only the open range and this customer's own labels are offered.

files.title: Files
files.hint: Tech packs, sketches, photos: added to the request for the office only; share them later from its files.
files.noRight: Your role does not add files.
files.later: Added once the request is made
files.fromMailHint: Tick the ones that are the customer's tech pack.
files.packVersion: Tech pack version (as they name it)
files.mailStays: The mail and its attachments stay with the request.

mail.contact: The sender is a contact of {name}
mail.domain: The sender writes from the domain of {name}
mail.prospect: Nexus does not know the sender: a prospect, from the mail's From
mail.subject: Subject
mail.gone: This mail is not there any more, or your role does not sort the mail

held.unnumbered: Requests are not numbered at this company yet: Admin › Documents & numbering
held.customer: Pick the customer, or record a prospect
held.basis: Choose the lawful basis for the prospect's details

leave.title: Discard this request?
leave.body: What you typed is not kept.
